title: Mystery Girlfriend
author: Patricia Johnson
description: Bruce, the son of a billionaire has met the girl of his dreams on Facebook – or so he thinks. His father is very against his plans to marry her but why?

messages.text: Hey buddy, why ain’t you answering your texts?
Sorry. Been busy.
Doing what or who?
Met the girl of my dreams on Facebook.
Really? That is what you thought about Linda.
But this is different.
Different how?
She understands, is beautiful, sweet, and kind.
How long have you known her?
Just two weeks and I love her.
After two weeks?
Just she means so much to me. Love at first sight.
Sorry, don’t believe in love at first sight or any sight.
Not all girls are bitches are like Colleen.
Haven’t found one yet who isn’t.
Do you want me to see if Laila has a sister or friend?
No thanks. I am done with the dating scene for awhile.
If you are sure.
I am sure but thanks.
Change your mind let me know.
So tell me more about Laila.
She is beautiful with dark hair and eyes and very curvy.
What have you two been doing?
I have taken her to romantic beach destinations.
Sounds nice.
I have even rented a concert hall just for the two of us.
That sounds cool.
This is real love and is going to last forever.
Forever is a long time.
I know that.
What is her last name?
Lafontaine.
One of the shoe tycoon’s daughters?
No, just a regular girl.
How is your father taking it?
Not very well. He is against it.
Yes, your father wanted you to marry Gloria Van House.
Yes, but she is an air head and…
And what buddy?
A cold fish in bed.
What kind of work does Laila do?
I am not sure. She works various hours.
She did not tell you?
No and all I know is it is public relations.
When do I get to meet her?
I will have to see when she is off work.
She has to have my stamp of approval first.
Your approval is all I need.
What about your father’s approval?
Father said he would disinherit me if I saw her again.
What are you going to do?
Keep seeing her.
Even if you lose all your money, cars, house?
Yes because I love her.
How is love going to put a roof over your head?
We will make it work. She has a job.
Has your father met her?
No.
Then how did your father find out you were seeing someone other than Gloria?
The credit card bills and the money I have been spending on her.
A lot of money?
Yes.
Wow! Now what?
Father is taking me to lunch.
Where?
The Italian Bistro. Father insisted this restaurant.
Why lunch?
Why not? You have to eat and that place is good as any.
Why that restaurant? You are not fond of Italian.
Hold on. Text from Laila.
I am back. Father said he is willing to compromise in regards to Laila and me.
That is a step in the right direction
He wants to discuss our upcoming marriage.
Enjoy. Text me to let me know how it went.
How did lunch go?
I got it now why Father invited me to The Italian Bistro.
Why?
We were driving to the restaurant.
And?
We passed that place where the prostitutes hang out looking for noon time customers.
So? They are there all the time.
Laila was among them.
